stem: On a perpendicular coordinate plane, the straight segment AB has ends A (-2, -5) and B (-2, -1). Plot the midpoint of AB.
solution: A and B have the same x-coordinate -2, so AB is parallel to the y-axis and the midpoint has x = -2.
The y-coordinate is halfway between -5 and -1: (-5 + -1) ÷ 2 = -3.

hints.text: Check the order of the pair: the first number is read along the x-axis, the second along the y-axis.
Both ends are on the negative side of an axis; look at the signs of the numbers when you find the halfway point.
Notice which coordinate the two ends share; the midpoint keeps that value, and only the other coordinate needs a halfway point.
